sloka: एवम् ते भाषमाणस्य पद्मा श्रीर् उपतिष्ठताम् ।यः त्वम् ज्येष्ठे नृप सुते पृथिवीम् दातुम् इच्चसि ॥२-७९-१५॥
transliteration: evam te bhāṣamāṇasya padmā śrīr upatiṣṭhatām ।yaḥ tvam jyeṣṭhe nṛpa sute pṛthivīm dātum iccasi ॥2-79-15॥

translations.english: May Lakshmi, goddess of prosperity, abide in you for having expressed your desire to bestow the kingdom upon the king's eldest son.
